patch_description: The third RTS refinement pass (q3 = qa/16) hurt tracking: correlation fell from 0.89 to 0.86 and noise_reduction from 0.55 to 0.39 while only marginally improving smoothness — over-smoothing bias. The fix: drop the third pass and instead make the *second* pass adaptive via a dynamics-aware blend between the pass-1 and pass-2 outputs. When the estimated signal dynamics (sigma_acc) are large relative to measurement noise, the aggressive Q/4 refinement over-flattens genuine trends, so we weight the pass-1 (more responsive) output more; when dynamics are small (mostly noise), we keep the full refinement. This recovers the 0.72-level accuracy while retaining most of the smoothness gain, with no extra compute versus the current three-pass version.
